# mazewall security-audit allowlist (OPERATOR-OWNED — do not edit as part of agent-driven changes)
#
# Format (one entry per line):
#   <FORBIDDEN_PATTERN>::<file-glob>::<reason>
#
# A matching entry downgrades a net-new forbidden-pattern occurrence in the pre-commit audit
# (.git/hooks/pre-commit, section 1) from a hard ERROR to a loud WARNING. Use this ONLY for
# semantics-preserving refactors or operator-reviewed changes; never to introduce new bypass
# behavior. Every entry must carry a reason referencing an issue or operator decision.
#
# Examples:
# FallbackBehavior.WARN_AND_BYPASS::enforcer/src/main/kotlin/io/mazewall/enforcer/api/ContainedExecutors.kt::issue-135555 stringly valueOf() replaced by enum reference; behavior identical (operator-approved 2026-08-23)
